originStory.title: Why Client Understanding Matters
originStory.subtitle: Lessons from watching brilliant code go to waste
originStory.story:
I've watched features that took weeks to build go unused. Perfect implementations of the wrong solution. I've been on both sides of that frustration.

Technical skills alone aren't enough. Beautiful code that doesn't solve what clients need wastes everyone's time.

This book exists because I want you to discover what users truly need, think about design, and create specifications that lead to success. These skills separate developers who ship features from developers who ship value.

creatorJourney.title: Lessons from Building Real Products
creatorJourney.subtitle: From painful failures to systematic success
creatorJourney.story: Early in my career, I learned the hard way that clients don't always know what they need. And neither did I. Projects failed not because of bad code, but because we built the wrong things. Everything changed when I discovered *User-Centered Design* and *Jobs-To-Be-Done* theory.
struggles: Building features that clients never used
Discovering requirements too late in the project
Realizing technical excellence doesn't guarantee project success
achievements: Built products for clients across multiple industries
Learned requirements discovery through real project successes and failures
Applied UX principles to ship software users love
